DEW-POINT EXCURSION (no valve; host, every 10-s tick): Td_ch = dew point of the chamber PV (and of WIMDA ref_Td when present; use the higher). HOLD if Td_ch > cap (23 C) + 1 C for 2 min, or t640_sample_RH > 45 % for 5 min while t640_asc_duty >= 95 %, or Td_ch > t640_box_T - 3 C, or Td_ch > tube heater - 5 C (when logged): step the RH set point back to the RH whose dew point is cap - 1 C at the current T set point, keep it there for the rest of the step (never re-raise within the step), log event, notify. ABORT to SAFE if t640_sample_RH > 60 % for 10 min, or > 75 % for 2 min, or Td_ch > cap + 3 C for 5 min, or Td_ch >= t640_box_T, or t640_sample_RH > 60 % for 5 min, or t640_fault = 1 for 5 min while t640_sample_RH > 45 % (t640_fault = WRNS.systemFaultWarning; the T640's Sample RH High alarm is snapshot-only and cannot be read every tick).

ABORT the night (-> SAFE) if: a pre-cycle check fails (pre1-pre3, except the provisional pre2 sample-RH check; the cycle does not start; a failed gate G0 check only blocks the start); pull-down to -18 C > 90 min; the dew-point excursion ABORT fires; no valid chamber reading for 5 min, or a set point unconfirmed for 5 min; T640 data stale > 5 min; humidity ON at a within-chart humid soak (T >= 15 C, past humidify_after) with RH PV < set - 10 % for 15 min (water or steam supply); IPS/T640 ratio moves > 2x from anchor A at a dry soak without an RH change. FLAG + notify (no abort): RH PV > set + 5 % for 15 min at a purge-ON soak (purge or compressed air short; replaces 'purge duty > 30 %', which the API cannot read). If the chamber leaves CONSTANT mode by itself (alarm, water out, over/under-temperature protection, panel STOP): do NOT restart it, do NOT enter SAFE, log + notify and end; the interlock wins.

SAFE STATE: humidity system OFF; T set point = the PV clamped to 22-30 C, ramped at 1.0 C/min up / 0.6 C/min down; on arrival humidity ON at 15 % with the dry-air purge ON for 60 min (end early once Td_ch <= 5 C and t640_sample_RH <= 35 % for 10 min; never longer than 90 min); then STOP (door closed: the next person opens it); notify on entry and on stop. The T640 keeps sampling the chamber and logging; nothing is masked at build time: rows whose measured T640 sample RH exceeds 50 % leave the fit; the heater duty and the fault bit are logged for diagnosis, not used by the fit.
